definitions.explanation: Liquid medication applied directly to the eyes, used for dry eyes, allergies, or other eye conditions.

examples.japanese: {目薬|めぐすり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦さした→さする：20837_sasuru⟧。
⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{乾|かわ}く→乾く：00786_kawaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で{目薬|めぐすり}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{手放|てばな}せない→手放す：05338_tebanasu⟧。
examples.english: My eyes get dry so I can't be without eye drops.

examples.japanese: ⟦{花粉症|かふんしょう}→花粉症：04409_kafunshou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{季節|きせつ}→季節：01304_kisetsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{目薬|めぐすり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: I use eye drops a lot during hay fever season.

notes:
{目薬|めぐすり} is used for various eye conditions.
